stem: Mira received `assets-0.9.tar.gz` and wants to see which files are inside before unpacking it. Which `tar` option lists an archive’s contents? Type the option with its dash, short or long form.
explanation: `-t` (long form `--list`) lists an archive’s members without extracting them. With `-f` naming the file and `-z` for gzip, the full command is `tar -ztf assets-0.9.tar.gz`; `-x` would extract instead.
